text:
maya: Heads-up — AcmeCorp reported intermittent 401s + latency spikes yesterday (billing also saw a blip). We have request IDs req_98765 and req_98766 in their payloads. Can someone collect a debug bundle and scrub PII before we attach to the PagerDuty ticket? Error snippet below.

maya: ```
ERROR: auth failed 401 for key tok_live_xxx
Trace: 2026-03-16T21:14:02Z request_id=req_98765 latency=1234ms
payload: {"user_email":"alice@acme.com","prompt":"Refund for invoice #12345..."}
```

liam: @maya which ticket number? do we need a curl repro or is the debug bundle enough?

maya: Ticket PD-1234. Need both — debug bundle for infra, curl repro for eng to reproduce. Please redact any emails/phones/names before upload.

jordan: I'll grab the bundle. Run:

jordan: ```
rdw-debug collect --req req_98765 --include-logs --out acme-req98765-debug.tar.gz
# then sanitize with rdw-debug scrub --input acme-req98765-debug.tar.gz --pii-mode pseudonymize
```

jordan: For curl repro, use:

jordan: ```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4-small","input":"<REDACTED_PROMPT>"}'
```

jordan: Replace <REDACTED_PROMPT> with a pseudonymized prompt (see below).

sophia: Redaction checklist:
- Replace names/emails/phones with [NAME_n]/[EMAIL_n]/[PHONE_n]
- Replace org identifiers (AcmeCorp) with [ORG]
- Keep request IDs & timings intact
- Do NOT include full raw customer prompts containing PII; include up to 200 tokens of context with entities replaced
- If you must include a mapping table, put it in the secure ticket comment and mark as restricted

jordan: Quick sed examples to pseudonymize in Linux:

jordan: ```bash
# emails -> [EMAIL_1]
sed -E "s/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[EMAIL_1]/g" file.json > file.redacted.json
# phone -> [PHONE_1]
sed -E "s/\+?[0-9][0-9()\- ]{7,}/[PHONE_1]/g" file.json > file.redacted.json
# names (manual mapping) -> [NAME_1]
```

devex-bot: Reminder: use the private S3 bucket s3://redwood-support-debug/ (restricted) for uploads. Attach link to PD-1234 and tag @sophia for approval.

maya: I'll do the initial scrub of the prompt and upload. @jordan can you verify latency traces after you collect the bundle? ETA 30m.

jordan: Yep, will verify and post findings here. If latency > 1.5s for generation step, we may escalate to perf team.

sophia: Approving upload once scrubbed. If anything seems like a data exfil risk, stop and DM me first.

liam: Thanks team. Once uploaded I'll add note to PD-1234 and CC the account owner.

maya: Thanks :thumbsup:
